# libs/v2d_infra

The items that all stages share are declared here only once (contract [`docs/contracts/data.md`](../../docs/contracts/data.md)):

- `paths.py`: tier names and directory layout.
- `tier_guard.py`: the tier-isolation guard. After Tier 2/3 code calls `forbid_tier1()`, any read of a Tier 1 directory raises an error. `test_tier_guard.py` tests this.
- `soma_fk.py`: the single entry point for SOMA forward kinematics, with a disk cache.
- `add_metrics.py`: local recomputation of ADD-AUC.
